notes: Synthetic: from OpenRouter's OpenAPI spec as vendored in its official SDK, github.com/OpenRouterTeam/python-sdk .speakeasy/in.openapi.yaml at 752139b7d0b9a71baece3468203a358e07a341b5 (2026-10-28; pinned as contractspec/subsets/openrouter), POST /responses (the /v1/responses passthrough, CreateResponse and StreamResponse: bodies go back unchanged; the server prices them from model and usage). responses_text is the request example and the 200 application/json example (OpenResponsesResult) verbatim. stream_responses_text follows the text/event-stream answer: ResponsesStreamingResponse is data lines alone (no event: names; the type is in each data object) ending in the [DONE] sentinel (x-speakeasy-sse-sentinel), and each event is its schema's example (OpenResponsesCreatedEvent, OpenResponsesInProgressEvent, StreamEventsResponseOutputItemAdded, ContentPartAddedEvent, TextDeltaEvent, TextDoneEvent, ContentPartDoneEvent, StreamEventsResponseOutputItemDone, StreamEventsResponseCompleted) with the model set to openai/gpt-4o for the examples' "gpt-4", sequence numbers made consecutive, the delta the examples skip filled in ("! How can I help you?" between "Hello" and the done text "Hello! How can I help you?"), and the completed response given its output item and usage (in OpenResponsesResult's shape, from the 200 example), which the server prices from. error_guardrail_blocked is the 403 "guardrail-blocked" example verbatim: its integer code is gap OR1, so it comes back as a 502. completions_text and completions_error_unauthorized drive TextCompletion against /api/v1/completions, which OpenRouter still serves as legacy text completions (OpenRouterTeam/docs c1b66058984cd1a184a6eb8d73030074f8c57e13, 2026-10-28: guides/features/router-metadata.mdx lists "/api/v1/completions (legacy text completions)" among the public completion routes) although its spec dropped the operation in python-sdk 1cad51ab (2026-02-05) without a deprecation note. The shape is from OpenRouter's OpenAPI spec at OpenRouterTeam/python-sdk 0c791b04d12fa94996bc78d0e00a5440a074785c (2026-01-21) .speakeasy/in.openapi.yaml, the last revision that models POST /completions (createCompletions): CompletionResponse (id, object "text_completion", created, model, provider, system_fingerprint, choices[] CompletionChoice {text, index, logprobs, finish_reason stop|length|content_filter|null, native_finish_reason, reasoning}, usage CompletionUsage {prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens}), with no example: the id, timestamp, provider, text and token counts are placeholders and the prompt is the request's. The docs' Response type (api_reference/overview.mdx) gives object as "chat.completion" for every route and a NonChatChoice of {finish_reason, text, error}; the value set takes both. The gateway never streams /v1/completions upstream (TextCompletion sets stream false), so there is no stream case. completions_error_unauthorized is the current spec's 401 example (UnauthorizedResponse, the one every operation shares) in the ErrorResponse shape the docs give (api_reference/errors-and-debugging.mdx: {error: {code: number, message, metadata?}}); 0c791b04's ChatError allows a string code as well, but every documented body has the integer HTTP status, gap OR1.
